title: Can I MASTER Spell Chess?
summary: chess.com Spell Chess vs online humans (up to 1700): before each move a player may cast a Jump spell (one piece can be jumped over as if it weren't there) or a Freeze spell (a 3x3 area cannot move). Spells recharge after three turns, the same spell can't be used twice in a row, and spell charges are limited. The king is captured rather than checkmated. Goal: win five games; fifth win in game 6, several wins by jump-spelling a pawn shield and taking the king.
rules: Before your move you may cast one spell.
Jump spell: target a piece; this turn your pieces may move through/over it as if it weren't there.
Freeze spell: target a 3x3 area; enemy pieces in it cannot move on their next turn.
Each spell recharges after three turns; you cannot use the same spell twice in a row; limited total charges per game (he notes 'I only have two jump spells', frames show counters x1, x4, x0).
Win by capturing the king (no checkmate needed); you can walk into 'check' (king capture rule).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / resign / flag. Series goal: 5 wins (5th in game 6).
